simple.meaning: קֵן (qên) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “a nest (as fixed), sometimes including the nestlings ; figuratively, a chamber or dwelling.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 6:14. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קֵן (H7064) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: קֵן (qên) / H7064 is traced through Genesis 6:14, Numbers 24:21, Deuteronomy 22:6, Deuteronomy 32:11 with generated occurrence evidence.

structuredEvidence.definition: a nest (as fixed), sometimes including the nestlings ; figuratively, a chamber or dwelling

firstOccurrence.englishText: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.

timeline.evidenceText: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.
He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said,
If you come across a bird’s nest on the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs, and the hen sitting on the young, or on the eggs, you shall not take the hen with the young.
As an eagle that stirs up her nest,
Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house,
Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up,
Blessed are those who dwell in your house.
As a bird that wanders from her nest,

My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”
For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.
Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,” says Yahweh.
Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!

definitions.full: H7064. qen קֵן noun masculine Deut 22:6 nest ; — absolute ׳ק Isa 10:14 +; construct קַןֿ Deut 22:6 ; suffix קִנּוֺ 32:11 +, etc.; plural קִנִּים Gen 6:14 ; — 1 nest , of bird Deut 22:6 ; Job 39:27 ; in sim Isa 10:14 ; Prov 27:8 , of nestlings Deut 32:11 ; Isa 16:2 ( מְשֻׁלָּח֑ קֵן ), perhaps also עִםקִֿנִּי Job 29:18 , but difficult, Che JQ July, 1897, 578 proposes זָקֵן or בִּוִקֻנַי (compare ᵐ5 ); nest on high, of rock-dwellings Num 24:21 (JE) Jer 49:16 ; Obadiah 4; figurative of Chaldeans' secure abode Hab 2:9 ; temple as secure home for Israel Psa 84:4 (figurative of swallow). 2 cells , like nests, in Noah's ark Gen 6:14 (P; read probably קִנִּים קִנִּים , so Lag Ol Bu Urg.255 Di Holz Gunk).
